title: 玻璃回收色選與純化
titleEn: Color sorting and purification of recycled glass
summary: 以「玻璃色系、陶瓷污染與品質收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow glass colours, ceramic contamination and quality balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.instruction: 容器玻璃、耐熱玻璃與陶瓷成分不同；先分用途與材料來源才能設定產品品質。
steps.instructionEn: Container glass, heat-resistant glass and ceramics differ in composition; define source and use before product quality.

steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: target cullet=feed*fraction;1000*0.85; calculation 1000*0.85 = 850 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical container-glass fraction.
steps.failure: 把透明物都當同類玻璃會引入不相容材料。
steps.failureEn: Treating every transparent item as the same glass admits incompatible material.
steps.check: 將耐熱玻璃與陶瓷獨立標籤。
steps.checkEn: Label heat-resistant glass and ceramics separately.

knowledge.text: 在「玻璃來源與規格」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 850 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把透明物都當同類玻璃會引入不相容材料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。

Contrast the fault scenario "Treating every transparent item as the same glass admits incompatible material." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「玻璃回收色選與純化」的「玻璃來源與規格：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「資源循環物料站」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Glass sources and specifications: Mechanism and observation” in “Color sorting and purification of recycled glass”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Circular-resource material station” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 顏色判斷依光源光譜、曝光和背景，需用標準色樣維持一致。

steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：normalized channel=G/(R+G+B);R=20,G=60,B=20；計算 60/(20+60+20) = 0.6 fraction。適用限制：簡化色特徵，不是完整分類器。

steps.failure: 光源老化可能讓相同玻璃跨越色類閾值。
steps.failureEn: Lamp aging can move the same glass across colour thresholds.
steps.check: 降低光源強度並檢查歸一化及噪音。
steps.checkEn: Reduce illumination and check normalization and noise.

steps.objective: 完成 顏色照明與白平衡 的量測或模型練習，記錄與假設的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Colour illumination and white balance and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
降低光源強度並檢查歸一化及噪音。
操作任務：在「顏色照明與白平衡」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.6 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「光源老化可能讓相同玻璃跨越色類閾值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Reduce illumination and check normalization and noise.
Action: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for colour illumination and white balance, first reproduce 0.6 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Lamp aging can move the same glass across colour thresholds." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：normalized channel=G/(R+G+B);R=20,G=60,B=20；計算 60/(20+60+20) = 0.6 fraction。適用限制：簡化色特徵，不是完整分類器。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: normalized channel=G/(R+G+B);R=20,G=60,B=20; calculation 60/(20+60+20) = 0.6 fraction. Applicability: Simplified colour feature, not a complete classifier.
steps.failure: 光源老化可能讓相同玻璃跨越色類閾值。
steps.failureEn: Lamp aging can move the same glass across colour thresholds.
steps.check: 降低光源強度並檢查歸一化及噪音。
steps.checkEn: Reduce illumination and check normalization and noise.
